title: Township joins the CSAF Godot Collection: now 24 addon packs
html:
Township is now part of the CSAF Godot Collection, version 1.3.0. If you own the collection, the new file is on your download page now, at no extra cost. It holds all 24 of our paid Godot 4.7 addon packs in one project, 1,273 presets for 2D games.

What joined

Township: NPC daily routines on your own map, and 50 working places that wake with their people. 50 presets. Its addon folder in the collection is the same files as its own download, and its demo opens from the browser like every other pack.

Also in this version

  • The browser now shows 24 cards in three rows of 8.

Every preset of all 24 packs was photographed again under Forward+ and Compatibility on the shipped bytes, 2,548 frames, with no engine error line.

The CSAF Godot Collection lists at $19.99. Township alone lists at $9.99.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, and the demo art comes from our own generated sets.
